shared_elements: human figure in relief on stone
stylized rendering of a head with patterned hair/headdress
incised curvilinear/circular motifs (rosettes in A, disc/ring forms in B)
low-relief carving of the human body
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures in low relief on stone, and both include circular/disc motifs (rosette bands in A, ring-and-disc forms on B's back), but these are generic correspondences. A shows a narrative procession of profile figures leading horned animals past a tree within framed ornamental borders, while B is a single frontal/monolithic figure with a massive head and isolated, sparse abstract markings and no scene, narrative, animals or border at all.
